title: The Arc A770 runs the SYCL vector-add smoke on Level Zero
command: kindi intel-sycl (oneAPI 2026.2 icpx build of tools/intel_sycl_vecadd.cpp, ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:gpu)
notes: REQ-0020 M2's SYCL half. The smoke is not a Kindi backend and makes no support claim: sycl-smoke.json has support_claim=false and scope names the runtime only. Machine roots in the tracked JSON are replaced with <oneapi-root> / <workdir>.
